notes.title: New Languages + Free Downloadable Soundtrack + New Capsules
notes.content:
New Languages
I have always believed that Lotte was at its best, when played in one's original language, and for that reason I have added a fully translated Japanese and German version of the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886291/61e91a4e7ef9d52fa8b1944571ccd8abdf779d40.png

Free Downloadable Soundtrack
Lotte is a very short experience, I know. I added a free downloadable soundtrack for those of you who enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere of the game and want to extend your stay. I used soundtracks like these a lot while working on the game. 

The ambience is based on this small village in Norway: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886291/2240d87c61ed52ce0a8c8d3b77feae714362c8b5.jpg

The soundtrack is also available on YouTube: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JNkIkP3Vhqs&t=732s&ab_channel=mathismeilby

New Capsules
I am also very proud to announce that Lotte has received a new set of hand drawn capsules by the talented Danish artist Theo Valbjørn. Here are a few examples from his hand:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886291/2134ca2f54c7ef82f28604327cd8ed6cefb9e8b3.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886291/1bd9230b672e36e3553c47c0e96298c2ac820481.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886291/383353cf29a3798687a04333351bccf339faa68c.png

If you want to see more of Theo’s work, you can do so on his Instagram and Art Station:

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/moshwroom/ 
Art Station: https://www.artstation.com/moshwroom


Thank you all so much for playing Lotte! 

All the best,
Mathis

notes.title: Lotte is out!
notes.content:
Finally!

After a year of hard work I am happy to announce that Lotte is finally available on Steam. 

This game would not have seen the light of day without all the amazing people who helped me along the way - you know who you are. Also thanks to all of you who bought the game on release, you made the release day a great one! And of course without the inspiration of Lise Lotte, none of this would have ever been considered. Thank you. 

I know the game is very short, but I can assure you that I put a lot of hours into those five minutes of playtime, I hope you will enjoy your time with the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886291/56819b846518ef32076766ac8775aef8e537ac42.gif

Greetings,
Mathis
